commit da906bb50701b4966b533b059717bca64031c48e
Author:     Alessandro Castellani <alessandro@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri Dec 6 09:45:28 2024 +0000
Commit:     Alessandro Castellani <alessandro@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Fri Dec 6 09:45:28 2024 +0000

    Bug 1934069 - Set show missed reminders preference to false by default. r=vineet,mkmelin
    
    Set the preference FLASE by default for all users.
    This will change also for those users that never touched that pref.
    I recommend doing this because this feature is not very useful and
    dismissing missed reminders doesn't always work.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D230575

diff --git a/calendar/base/calendar.js b/calendar/base/calendar.js
index 57afc317cc5..d92f7cd70e2 100644
--- a/calendar/base/calendar.js
+++ b/calendar/base/calendar.js
@@ -33,7 +33,7 @@ pref("calendar.agenda.days", 14);
 
 // alarm settings
 pref("calendar.alarms.show", true);
-pref("calendar.alarms.showmissed", true);
+pref("calendar.alarms.showmissed", false);
 pref("calendar.alarms.playsound", true);
 pref("calendar.alarms.soundType", 0);
 pref("calendar.alarms.soundURL", "chrome://calendar/content/sound.wav");
diff --git a/calendar/base/src/CalAlarmService.sys.mjs b/calendar/base/src/CalAlarmService.sys.mjs
index af337012174..a181080b36c 100644
--- a/calendar/base/src/CalAlarmService.sys.mjs
+++ b/calendar/base/src/CalAlarmService.sys.mjs
@@ -412,7 +412,7 @@ CalAlarmService.prototype = {
       return;
     }
 
-    const showMissed = Services.prefs.getBoolPref("calendar.alarms.showmissed", true);
+    const showMissed = Services.prefs.getBoolPref("calendar.alarms.showmissed", false);
 
     const alarms = aItem.getAlarms();
     for (const alarm of alarms) {
diff --git a/calendar/test/browser/eventDialog/browser.ini b/calendar/test/browser/eventDialog/browser.ini
index 85f569c0cc4..d1a639e5cf1 100644
--- a/calendar/test/browser/eventDialog/browser.ini
+++ b/calendar/test/browser/eventDialog/browser.ini
@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 head = head.js
 prefs =
   calendar.item.promptDelete=false
+  calendar.alarms.showmissed=true
   calendar.timezone.local=UTC
   calendar.timezone.useSystemTimezone=false
   calendar.week.start=0
diff --git a/calendar/test/browser/providers/browser.ini b/calendar/test/browser/providers/browser.ini
index 84d6133696e..439fd3faecf 100644
--- a/calendar/test/browser/providers/browser.ini
+++ b/calendar/test/browser/providers/browser.ini
@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 head = head.js
 prefs =
   calendar.item.promptDelete=false
+  calendar.alarms.showmissed=true
   calendar.debug.log=true
   calendar.debug.log.verbose=true
   calendar.timezone.local=UTC
diff --git a/calendar/test/unit/xpcshell.ini b/calendar/test/unit/xpcshell.ini
index a56fb1cb797..6bb2c6df925 100644
--- a/calendar/test/unit/xpcshell.ini
+++ b/calendar/test/unit/xpcshell.ini
@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 head = head.js
 prefs =
   calendar.timezone.local=UTC
+  calendar.alarms.showmissed=true
   calendar.timezone.useSystemTimezone=false
   calendar.itip.updateInvitationForNewAttendeesOnly=true
   mailnews.oauth.loglevel=Debug
